name: Circuit Zandvoort
layout: Grand Prix circuit (2020+ with banked Turns 3 and 14)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap highway=raceway ways (circuit mapped 2024), finish line from OSM node 12148116710 raceway=finish; Overpass API, (c) OSM contributors ODbL
sources.width: Measured: white edge-line pairs on perpendicular profiles every 6 m in PDOK Luchtfoto Actueel_orthoHR (https://service.pdok.nl/hwh/luchtfotorgb/wms/v1_0), Viterbi-linked, median/smoothed; gaps interpolated
sources.elevation: AHN4 DTM 0.5 m via PDOK WCS https://service.pdok.nl/rws/ahn/wcs/v1_0 (coverage dtm_05m), bilinear, robust median + ~15 m smoothing
sources.camber: Crossfall from AHN4 DTM 0.5 m samples at both track edges (1.2 m inset); at the progressively banked Hugenholtzbocht (T3) and Arie Luyendijkbocht (T14) the edge-to-edge mean slope is used (bowl profile: ~5% inside to ~30% at the outer edge), clamped at +-20%
sources.trim: Twisty, narrow, few straights, banked corners: high downforce (close to Hungary)
sources.pitLimit: FIA raised Zandvoort pit lane limit from 60 to 80 km/h from 2025 (F1 2025/2026 event notes)
sources.pitLoss: Formula1.com "Need to know" 2026 Dutch GP: pit stop time loss 18.09 s
sources.raceLaps: 2026 Dutch GP 72 laps; sprint weekend 2026, Sprint 24 laps

notes: Clockwise. Station 0 on the finish/timing line (OSM raceway=finish); the start line is ~55 m further on. Turn numbering per F1 map (14 turns). 2026 was the final Dutch GP.
